title: Craft
body:
Syntax: craft tool <rod|axe|pickaxe|hoe|pot|chisel> <iron|steel|chakra>
Also: craft rod iron, craft axe steel, craft pickaxe chakra, craft hoe iron, craft pot steel, craft chisel chakra.

Job-tool smithing requires Bukijutsu level 25+. Iron tools use Sturdy Oak + Iron Ingot (400 uses), Steel uses Ironwood + Steel Ingot (650 uses), Chakra uses Ancient Heartwood + Chakra Steel Ingot (1000 uses). Crafting takes 20 seconds. Hoes improve higher-level Farming crop odds; upgraded cooking pots reduce burn chance; upgraded chisels work with GEMCUT and INLAY at Gemcutter job levels 15/35/75. All crafted tools use their recipe durability.

Other crafting: craft weapon <type> <name> / craft armor <slot> <name> (Bukijutsu level 25+ or other classes level 100+). For Chakra Aura armor use CRAFT ARMOR AURA <name>, CRAFT ARMOR CA <name>, or CRAFT ARMOR CHAKRA AURA <name>. Choose iron, steel or chakra steel at the material prompt; weapons and armor consume two matching metal ingots, no wood required. Craft pill <antidote|medicine> <level> is Bukijutsu-only from level 25.

Diamond inlays: use a Cut Diamond (Gemcutter 80) during forge creation or with INLAY on existing forged weapons/armor or any tool. It doubles remaining and maximum durability/uses, without granting combat stats. Only Diamond may be inlaid into tools. One Diamond per item.

Names can repeat: every newly forged weapon and armor receives a separate VNUM, even when its display name matches another item. Your item keeps its distinct stats, durability, gems and creator record. Use numbered keywords such as 2.blade to select another item with the same name.
